hook: Anthropic's AI runs on gas and coal

beats.say: According to a new breakdown, by 2028, 87 percent of the power behind Anthropic's AI will come from natural gas, and 11 percent from coal.
Its power use could emit 17 to 38 million tons of CO2 a year — more than all of California's power generation.
Four in five on-site generators use inefficient simple-cycle turbines, and the AI boom keeps adding demand.
